document.name: CampusSphere Enterprise Course Seed Dataset
document.scope: All course records for CSE, EEE, ECE, MECH, AGRI, AIDS, BT, IT

seedRules.courseId: Unique per department-semester seed record; never use course name as identifier
seedRules.masterCourseId: Stable identity derived from source course code + course name so shared courses can be reused across offerings
seedRules.courseCodeVariants: Slash-separated source codes are preserved as variants; do not silently split them into invented courses
seedRules.category: Normalized application category while retaining categorySource exactly from curriculum
seedRules.yearOfStudy: Derived from semester: Sem 1-2 Year 1, Sem 3-4 Year 2, Sem 5-6 Year 3, Sem 7-8 Year 4
seedRules.courseOffering: This file defines course/master seed data only; CourseOffering, FacultyAssignment and Enrollment are separate seed stages
seedRules.units: Create Unit 1-5 for every course during the course-offering/content seed stage
seedRules.semester8: No Semester 8 courses are included because the curriculum source does not provide them
